zoning.road_width_source: rulegraph/taylorsville_params_draft.json street_widths_13_21_100.row_widths_ft.local = 50 ft ROW (Taylorsville LDC Sec. 13.21.100). rulegraph.note: 'clean' reflects geometric validation only. RuleGraph verdicts are reported separately with a per-scheme applicable-rule count ('rulegraph_applicable_rules'). A scheme is compliance-confirmed only when its rulegraph verdict is PASS with at least one applicable verified rule. A PASS with zero applicable rules means no verified rule in the store covered the parcel's district — that is 'no applicable verified rules', not a compliance finding.

use_allowance.note: Use-allowance verdicts are machine-evaluated against the human-verified §21A.33 use-table packs: 191 M-1/OS/PL rows (human verdicts by Rohan, 2026-09-23) + 322 MU-5/MU-6/MU-11 rows (batch-verified by Rohan, 2026-09-23; the machine evaluates, never verifies). UNKNOWN never means allowed — it means the use could not be confirmed (no proposed uses supplied, no use rows for the district, no matching verified row, or an ambiguous row such as M1-U-28). MANUAL_REVIEW means a qualifying-provision footnote whose text was not retrieved needs a human read. FAIL rows are blank-cell code facts (the §21A.33 legend: blank = not permitted).
